newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian stocks end week at record high.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian stocks end week at record high.

text.p: *Stocks ended the week at a record close with attention centred on food group Burns Philp. Total volume 448.9 million, value A$1.075 million, 1,227 traded, 358 steady, 435 up, 434 down
Australian shares capped a strong week with a record close on Friday, the market healthy enough to absorb profit-taking on News Corp and some bank stocks which posted strong gains on Thursday.
Key share barometer, the All Ordinaries index set its second record closing high in a row and its third for the week, ending 17.2 points firmer at 2,655.3.
The June share price index finished 10 points up at 2,663, a 7.7 point premium to the underlying index.
Food group Burns Philp led turnover after a mystery buyer snared 14.7 percent of its shares before the opening bell.
Diversified manufacturer Pacific Dunlop was another active stock, closing the session with a gain of 10 cents at A$3.68 on turnover of 11.3 million shares.
Dealers could not point to any news driving the stock but said its cyclical nature made it a favourite after a good night on Wall Street.
Resources outperformed industrials with market heavyweights, the Broken Hill Pty Co and Rio Tinto both finishing the week with solid gains.
Amongst the industrials, two oustanding performers were Brambles Industries and Westpac Banking Group.
